title: sar_swarm 2.2: code and data for the HBF (hierarchical Bayesian field) method of swarm search for victims under an inaccurate prior map
description:
Python simulation package sar_swarm (version 2.2) with the HBF method (hierarchical Bayesian potential field) for coordinating a UAV swarm searching for victims when the reliability of the prior probability map is unknown. Version 2.1 contained the development scripts and logs (maps 100–159), the pre-registered confirmatory protocol S1 with its SHA-256 checksum and the run logs of all confirmatory experiments (maps 11–60). Version 2.2 adds the extension: structured map error S4 and the HBF-S method (protocol S4, development on maps 100–139, confirmation on maps 61–99), the N_v series, a real-terrain map rasterised from OpenStreetMap data (Carpathians), and the ground truth outside the hypothesis class S4-M (protocol S4M, maps 160–199), with run logs (runs.jsonl), statistical analyses, correctness tests and figures 1–4. Negative results are reported as obtained.

Code and run logs: MIT licence. Map data in code/realmaps/karpaty: © OpenStreetMap contributors, Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0; the MIT licence does not apply to these data.

Програмний пакет sar_swarm 2.2 з методами HBF і HBF-S: скрипти й журнали розроблення, протоколи підтверджувальних перевірок S1, S4 і S4M, журнали всіх прогонів, статистичний аналіз, тести й рисунки до рукопису «Ієрархічний байєсівський метод ройового пошуку постраждалих за невідомої надійності апріорної карти».
